svg.title: Featured project: A self-hosted bilingual blog
svg.desc: A self-hosted bilingual blog. Built from scratch: a static Astro site, a .NET API and a native Markdown editor, shipped with Docker to a small VPS. Bilingual: Spanish and English. Markdown editor with history and scheduling. Photo and video hero: AVIF, WebP and AV1. Accessible: WCAG 2.2 AA. Static site + .NET API + Docker. Stack: Astro · React · ASP.NET Core · EF Core · SQLite · Caddy · ffmpeg · libvips. Visitors only get pre-built HTML; publishing a post rebuilds the site and swaps it atomically.
